blurb:
Discover Pearl Harbor and historic Honolulu aboard a spacious Deluxe Gold Royal Star coach featuring panoramic windows, reclining seats, seat belts and an onboard restroom. An original Pearl Harbor video, cold bottled water, refreshing mint and hand-towelette service add comfort throughout your journey.
Your professional Royal Star driver-guide brings Hawaii’s history to life through engaging narration while providing helpful guidance and personal assistance along the way.
Choose the five-hour USS Arizona Memorial and Honolulu City Tour, upgrade to the eight-hour tour with admission to the Battleship Missouri, or select the nine-hour Ultimate Tour with admission to both the Battleship Missouri and Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum.

Guests using the Ford Island shuttle to the Battleship Missouri or Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum may be required to present a valid government-issued photo ID. International visitors should carry a passport. Bags of any size are not permitted at Pearl Harbor.
